ac_engine_upgrade_desc.value: "More mobility give tactical and strategic advantages, as well as allowing more armor without being slowed down significantly."

air_defence_desc.value: "By training our pilots to be constantly on the lookout, even when there is apparently no danger, their chances of intercepting enemy planes is increased."

air_superiority_desc.value: "Achieving Air Superiority will make it more difficult for enemy bombers to be used against our country, to allow our bombers to be used against our enemies."

armor_desc.value: "The largest and strongest armor that money can buy."

ballistic_missile_equipment_desc.value: "An unmanned ballistic missile for strategic bombing"

britain.18.d.value: "It is no secret that no love is lost between George VI and the [Root.GetRulingParty]. Voices in parliament are now calling for his resignation in favour of his exiled brother, Edward the VIII. This is a man less foreign to the idea of unity through strength, and a man with a vision for England. His are the qualities we seek in a leader of our nation!"

canal_kiel_desc.value: "The Kiel Canal Locks are needed in place in order for the canal to operate at full capacity, and destroying them would hinder shipping and movement for a long time."

canal_panama_desc.value: "The Panama Canal Locks are needed in place in order for the canal to operate at full capacity, and destroying them would hinder shipping and movement for a long time."

canals_tt.value: "Wrest control of the canal's banks within the next month to prevent the enemy plan."

cv_nav_bomber_equipment_desc.value: "Naval Bombers are able to perform attacks against enemy ships."

dam_desc.value: "Dams provide additional power to a state, improving industry and resource output."

decisions.1.a.value: "Anyone will do, we just need someone to lead our armies."

decisions.1.b.value: "We need someone who at least knows what they're doing."

decisions.1.c.value: "Quality is paramount, we should not compromise on cost."

decisions.1.desc.value: "Certain officers in the lower echelons of the military have expressed 'alternative' views on the country's leadership. To limit suspicion, we should limit our efforts to approaching only one potential supporter, and we should spare no resources in buying their loyalty."

decisions.2.desc.value: "Certain officers in the upper echelons of the military have expressed 'alternative' views on the country's leadership. To limit suspicion, we should limit our efforts to approaching only one potential supporter, and we should spare no resources in buying their loyalty."

explosive_ammo_equipment_desc.value: "A high-explosive projectile that can be fired from a Large Caliber Multi-Charge Gun, capable of reaching targets at very long range."

floating_harbor_equipment_1_desc.value: "A series of pontoons and pre-fabricated concrete structures that can be moved across water and assembled within hours to create a sheltered landing space to unload supplies."

floating_harbor_equipment_desc.value: "A series of pontoons and pre-fabricated concrete structures that can be moved across water and assembled within hours to create a sheltered landing space to unload supplies."

heavy_cruiser_desc.value: "A large armored cruiser that is pretty flexible. A good choice for nations who can't afford to build larger capital ships."

jaeger_desc.value: "§LExpert in guerilla warfare and sabotage operations behind enemy lines.§!"

jet_fighter_equipment_desc.value: "Fighters are fast and nimble and can do many jobs. Everything from fighting for air superiority, protect your bombers and intercept the enemies bombers."

jet_strat_bomber_equipment_desc.value: "Strategic Bombers attack enemy buildings and infrastructure, starving them of precious industry."

jet_tac_bomber_equipment_desc.value: "Tactical Bombers are smaller fast bombers that can help out ground troops and bomb enemy buildings."

landmark_berlin_volkshalle_desc.value: "The Volkshalle stands as a testament to our people's indomitable spirit, and their prideful will to dominate the globe. It will show the world that, through the might of conquest, anything is possible, and the fatherland can make even the most impossible task possible."

lar_collab_gov.1.d.value: "[From.GetNameDefCap] have recently increased their efforts to build collaboration within our nation. A number of [This.GetAdjective] politicians have started speaking rather sympathetically about the [From.GetAdjective] regime, and many partisans within our nation are turning their [From.GetRulingIdeology] sentiment into direct support for [From.GetNameDef].\n\nThe growing [From.GetAdjective] influence in our nation will undoubtedly lower [Root.GetAdjective] resistance and may even lead to a new [From.GetRulingIdeology] government in collaboration with [From.GetNameDef] in the event that [Root.GetNameDef] should capitulate."

marines_desc.value: "Troops specializing in amphibious warfare are growing ever more indispensable. Improvised methods and equipment become things of the past as our naval infantry is supported by specialized landing craft and training."

mech_cost_upgrade_desc.value: "Optimizations to the design and substitution of less important materials allow the vehicle to be built faster, but suffering slightly more defects."

modern_armor_desc.value: "Modern Tanks have evolved to deal with most battlefield situations. Powerful guns and sloped armor have eliminated the need for specialized tanks."

mothership_equipment_desc.value: "A very large plane that carries several fighter planes into combat, allowing for further reach than would normally be possible. The carrier of the sky."

motorized_desc.value: "Motorized infantry transportation, such as trucks and motorcycles."

news.159.a.value: "Will this lead to eternal peace or another war?"

news.159.d_01.value: "[From.GetLeader] announced today that [From.GetName] has reached out to form a new alliance. [From.GetFactionName] have made public their intent to cooperate in the case of war.\n\nAlthough great coalitions can deter against aggression, we've seen the consequences they bring when conflict does arise. The intentions of the different parties joining in this new alliance is still debatable, but what purpose it may end up serving may be unknown even to its instigators."

news.159.d_02.value: "It has been theorized that democracies do not go to war with each other, but this does not mean they are guaranteed to aid each other in wars. As political interests are diverse and the people want peace, entering a war often comes at a great cost for these nations.\n\nHowever, this has not stopped [From.GetName] from announcing today that they have formed a military alliance, the [From.GetFactionName], to join forces in protecting their people and their ideals."

news.159.d_03.value: "Even [From.GetName], famed for its faith in the strength and superiority of its people and nation, is not beyond forming alliances with those they respect. [From.GetLeader] announced today that the final agreements had been made about the [From.GetFactionName], a military coalition which purportedly room only for honorable nations destined for greatness.\n\nWhether this greatness is intended to come from building the ideal society within the borders of the respective nations or by working together to expand beyond them, the world may not know until it is too late."

news.159.d_04.value: "Despite the recent Soviet focus on communism in one country, the internationalist roots of the movement transcend borders. This solidarity with workers around the world was a key element in [From.GetLeader]'s speech today when the [From.GetFactionName] was announced.\n\nGoing beyond a political International, this is an alliance that binds the countries militarily, with both regimes promising to aid each other against outside threats. Whether it will act as a sword or a shield for the communist revolution remains to be seen."

nuclear_missile_equipment_desc.value: "A medium range ballistic missile capable of carrying a nuclear warhead"

paratroopers_desc.value: "By incorporating airborne forces into our army, we can make forced entries and position key troops in previously inaccessible areas, allowing for new tactical opportunities."

railway_gun_desc.value: "Railways offer an opportunity to move heavy guns far inland at a reasonable speed, allowing us to bombard enemy position at great range and with good effect."

railway_gun_equipment_desc.value: "A heavy cannon mounted on a railway carriage for transportation."

ranger_battalion_desc.value: "Rangers are leading specialists when it comes to fighting in dense and vegetated terrain."

rangers_desc.value: "Specializing in infiltration and tactical awareness, we will benefit from accentuating the hostile environment training our Rangers receive."

repair_ship_1_desc.value: "Repair ships carry heavy-duty recovery equipment that can mean the difference between a badly damaged ship able to limp back to port, and a sunk one."

repair_ship_2_desc.value: "An even more capable repair ship, with state of the art equipment able to save friendly warships from all but the most critical damage."

rocket_artillery_equipment_2_desc.value: "Spin-stabilized rockets, increasing the range of lighter artillery batteries."

rocket_artillery_equipment_desc.value: "Rocket artillery is less accurate and has a much lower sustained rate of fire than batteries of traditional artillery guns. However, they have the capability to simultaneously deluge a target with multiple rockets with devastating effect."

rocket_interceptor_equipment_desc.value: "Short range interceptor powered by a chemical rocket engine."

sam_missile_equipment_desc.value: "A rocket intended to quickly climb to reach enemy bombers, and explode in their close proximity."

ship_hull_nuclear_submarine_desc.value: "With nuclear reactors, our submarines can operate for a very long time underwater, while maintaining high speed, thus making them extremely deadly tool in our arsenal "

strat_bomber_intercontinental_equipment_.value: "A giant aircraft specifically designed for ultra-long range missions, intended to enable strategic bombing across continents."

super_heavy_railway_gun_equipment_desc.value: "A colossal weapon of unmatched power and precision, which will stand as a testament to relentless pursuit of military superiority of our country."

support_ship_1_desc.value: "Support ships are non-combat vessels focused on logistical support of the battlefleet, extending operational endurance with reserve stocks of fuel and supplies."

support_ship_2_desc.value: "Operational experience allows for a more advanced and capable support ship, able to sustain the battlefleet over even greater distances."

support_weapons_desc.value: "Automatic weapons are becoming more portable. Submachine guns have already proven effective and the development of hand-held support weapons must continue."

train_equipment_desc.value: "Trains transport supplies from the Supply Capital to Supply Hubs connected by rail."

usa.3.d.value: "The diplomatic and economic sanctions we have suffered from the United States appears to have been the beginning of something more threatening. The American Pacific Fleet has been stationed in the naval base in Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, clearly signaling that the Americans will maintain a strong presence in the Pacific and continue supporting our enemies. Striking against the base at this point may give us the element of surprise."

usa.4.d.value: "Having taken a stance against the Germans, the US appear interested in ensuring Britain stands strong against the German threat. They are, however, also concerned with maintaining their own naval presence in the Atlantic. In exchange for several of our naval bases, they will supply our nation with destroyer ships. The ships have been in reserve, but accepting will still strengthen the military bonds between our nations, and may be a wise decision."

usa.5.d.value: "Despite our preparations and good intentions, Britain has refused our offer of old Destroyers in exchange for their naval bases."
